gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-anek-malaya: Raw and tactical, Capture Smallz stamps its big-bodied lowercase across the top. Anek Malayalam follows with curves that never quite close and capitals barely taller than the lowercase, a quiet foil to all that bluntness.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-anek-odia: Capture Smallz hits first with chunky, big-bodied lowercase and a raw, tactical bite, while Anek Odia stays clean underneath. Its rounds hang open like unlatched hooks.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-anek-tamil: Anek Tamil brings big round lowercase bowls and half-unwrapped c and s shapes, modern and easy on the eye. And Capture Smallz, raw and big-bodied, gives that smoothness something rough to push against.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu reads with wide, tall bowls setting the pace, clean and approachable, its rounds left unsealed like unlatched hooks. But Capture Smallz up top is raw and tactical, so the page swings between blunt and friendly.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-anuphan: Big-bodied lowercase gives Capture Smallz a raw, tactical swagger, the kind of letters that look ready to be stenciled onto a crate. Anuphan sits beside it, round and open.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-arimo: Tactical is the first word that comes to mind for Capture Smallz, with its big-bodied, raw lowercase. Arimo steps in with a tall mean line and spacious gaps in its rounds, so a larger heading over smaller text would suit it.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-armata: Raw and tactical, Capture Smallz fills its lowercase out to the full letter height. Armata offers the same generous bodies but spreads them with wide gaps between characters, which loosens the whole pair.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-athiti: Athiti has a mean line set high and a gap you can see through in each s, friendly and contemporary. Athiti also keeps its crossbars as thick as its stems, whereas Capture Smallz, raw and big-bodied, cuts them low.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-atkinson-hy: Atkinson Hyperlegible feels approachable, with clipped ascenders and wide-set terminals on its s. Capture Smallz is best at raw, big-bodied punch, while Atkinson Hyperlegible does its best work in quiet, clear lines of text.

Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono reads open and approachable, its counters breathing into the white space around them. And Capture Smallz, raw and tactical, brings big-bodied lowercase that makes the mono's stretched, stencil-bridge spacing feel deliberate.
